editorial:
Imagine being a college student who is already struggling with your mental health and then falling hard for the one person you should not be dating: your professor. That is exactly what happens to Caroline. She finds a spark with Ben, but since their relationship is forbidden, it only makes things more intense. You will feel the tension build up as their secret romance turns into an obsession. The movie feels like a slow burn that eventually catches fire, showing you how a bad relationship can make someone lose their grip on reality.

What really makes this work is the acting, especially the way Caroline's mood shifts from happy to totally broken. The pacing is steady, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you prefer fast action. If you enjoy dark dramas about people making bad choices, you will love this. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the small details in the scenes, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a heavy watch, but it stays with you long after the credits roll.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when Ben tries to end things for good. Caroline cannot handle the rejection and has a complete breakdown. In a shocking turn, her instability leads to a violent confrontation that puts her own family in danger. The movie ends with Caroline facing the wreckage of her life, showing that her love for Ben was actually a dangerous obsession. She ends up losing everything, proving that her mental health struggles were too much to ignore.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves intense character studies and tragic love stories.
